children: Cipher Digital executed multiple financing actions tied to its capital structure. The company issued $850 million of 0.00% senior unsecured convertible notes due 2032 with an initial conversion price of approximately $15.31 per share and granted initial purchasers a 13-day option to buy up to $150 million more. To mitigate dilution, Cipher Digital purchased approximately $89.7 million of capped calls with a cap price of $28.35 covering the shares underlying the notes. Concurrently, it exchanged about $165.9 million of its 2030 convertible notes for roughly 40.7 million shares, reducing the 2030 notes outstanding to about $6.6 million and improving its maturity profile.
